abstract: Maintains chain-of-custody verification logs and quality-control blank quotas
system_message:
You are the Forensic laboratory quality lead (LAB), responsible for maintaining chain-of-custody verification logs and quality-control blank quotas, as well as managing volatile solvent screening protocols across investigative sampling batches.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains chain-of-custody verification logs and quality-control blank quotas（ANAL）
information_points.content:
LAB-ANAL-BI4：For the Continuous membrane interface probe transect plan, forensic chain-of-custody compliance is not satisfied across planned sample handling pipelines, and the blind quality-control sample allocation is 45 samples.
LAB-ANAL-ZWD：For the Compound-specific isotope diffusion sampling plan, forensic chain-of-custody compliance is verified across all planned soil, vapor, and groundwater sample handling pipelines, and the blind quality-control sample allocation is 30 samples.
LAB-ANAL-ACM：For the High-resolution multi-level piezometer profiling plan, forensic chain-of-custody compliance is confirmed across all planned soil, vapor, and groundwater sample handling pipelines, and the blind quality-control sample allocation is set at 30 samples.

information_points.title: Volatile solvent screening（SOLV）
information_points.content:
LAB-SOLV-SD3：Under the Continuous membrane interface probe transect plan, the gas chromatography batch runtime for volatile solvent screening is 50 min per injection sequence.
LAB-SOLV-WAK：Under the High-resolution multi-level piezometer profiling plan, the gas chromatography batch runtime for volatile solvent screening is 35 min per injection sequence.
LAB-SOLV-LFV：Under the Compound-specific isotope diffusion sampling plan, the gas chromatography batch runtime for volatile solvent screening is 20 min per injection sequence.
